subject: Archaeology
title: The Yamnaya Migration
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: The Yamnaya Migration.

hook.text: DNA proved that steppe herders swept across Europe 5,000 years ago, reshaping the population.

buildup.text: The Yamnaya herded cattle, rode horses, and built wagons on the Russian steppe.

discovery.text: Genomes show they spread across Europe in centuries, carrying Indo-European languages.

twist.text: Up to 75 percent of male lineages were replaced in some areas — pointing to violence.

climax.text: The migration explains why European, Iranian, and Indian languages are all related.

punchline.text: One group from the steppe shaped half the planet's languages.

quiz.question: What did ancient DNA reveal about the Yamnaya migration?
options: The Yamnaya were peaceful traders who exchanged goods but not genes
They replaced up to 75% of male lineages in parts of Europe
They migrated from Europe to the steppe, not the other way
